justification: Verdict INVALID. The assessment's primary flawed step (lines 0026-0038, Case 2 abandoned with 'we must adjust our approach', then line 0058 appeals to the abandoned induction) is genuine and its counterexample verifies: T' = path a-b-c-d with IH vertex v=b is valid for T' (components sizes 1 and 2, both <= 2), but attaching leaf u to d gives T = a-b-c-d-u (n=5) where T-b has component {c,d,u} of size 3 > 5/2, so the IH vertex fails in T. Additionally, the assessment explicitly identifies the ground-truth defect itself: it states that line 0054 miscounts the back component containing v_i as n - |C| - 1 when the author's own description ('all other components plus v_i') gives n - |C|, and that the claimed strict decrease / bound is unjustified. This is exactly the confirmed ground-truth flaw (formula off by one in every case; bound n - |C| - 1 < n/2 - 1 false), so the assessment targets the same defect (rephrased, without an explicit numeric witness for it) in addition to the genuine Case-2 incompleteness.
